description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and rear roof extension with front & rear roof windows.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: PAT-07-PL01, PAT-07-PL02, PAT-07-PL03, Amended plans: PAT-07-PL04C , Amended plans: PAT-07-PL05C, PAT-07-PL06, PAT-07-PL07, Unreferenced Location Plan Received 16/08/2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the front or rear roof planes or elevations of the development hereby permitted.
Condition : 5 - The window(s) to be fitted on the front and rear roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
